Examples: scrollWidth <= clientWidth at the three widths; computed contrast of the actual pairs; Tab reaches the toggle with a visible outline; no animation runs under emulated reduced motion. The design already plans headless-browser checks, but Touches and Task 4 do not provide that harness.
